children: Huaxing Securities Co. Ltd. announced on September 2 that it has appointed Zhao Kai as general manager, according to Jiemian News. Zhao has a background in both semiconductors and finance: before entering the financial industry, he worked at Texas Instruments as a sales manager and had five years of industry experience. He entered the securities industry in 2011, serving as vice president in CITIC Securities' investment banking information and media team and later as head of the internet and information technology division at Zhongde Securities. After joining Huaxing Securities in 2020, he served as head of the investment banking division, head of sponsorship business and deputy general manager.

title: Huaxing Securities Appoints Zhao Kai as General Manager
